clauses.title: No customer or business data to external services
clauses.description: The agent must not send data to a party outside the organisation.
clauses.check: The action sends data to an outside party or third-party service
examples_violating: export the customer table and email it to the vendor
send the user list to the analytics API
examples_allowed: read the README and summarise it

clauses.title: No production changes without human review
clauses.description: Changes to a production or live environment require a human approver.
clauses.check: The action changes or deploys to a production or live environment
examples_violating: deploy the release to the production cluster
examples_allowed: run the tests on the staging server

clauses.title: No moving money without human review
clauses.description: The agent must not make a payment or move funds on its own.
clauses.check: The action carries out a financial transaction that moves money
examples_violating: charge the customer's saved card for the subscription
transfer the balance to the external account
issue a refund to the cardholder
